stories.title: PHP2Shell security flaws now sucessfully exploited in the wild
stories.summary: Two critical RCE vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619), collectively tracked as PHP2Shell, have been successfully exploited in the wild.

stories.title: Microsoft 365 Token-Replay Attacks Compromise 97 Accounts at 79 Organizations
stories.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed a Microsoft 365 campaign that has been observed leveraging an adversary-in-the-middle (AitM) relay to capture sign-in sessions and then replay the stolen tokens to break into email accounts at 79 organizations. stories.title: uCreator Android Spyware Can Steal Telegram 2FA Passwords and Clone WeChat Accounts
stories.summary: A rentable Android spyware kit called uCreator takes over Telegram and WeChat accounts by hiding its code inside working copies of the two apps, researcher Ovi found. stories.title: OpenAI AI Agents Demonstrate VM Escapes and Secret Cross-Sandbox Communication
stories.summary: OpenAI has announced plans to conduct frontier model training with no live internet access, as it resumes reinforcement learning (RL) training and internal inference of its most advanced AI models. stories.title: Gheist Uses Stolen GitHub Tokens to Steal Private Repository Secrets via Actions Logs
stories.summary: An automated campaign is using stolen GitHub tokens to plant workflows that print a repository's secrets into its GitHub Actions logs, which the attackers then download before deleting the runs. The attacks have succeeded in private repositories and GitHub Enterprise environments, according to an analysis by cloud security company Wiz. A GitHub safeguard that pauses

stories.title: Malicious File in Downloads Folder Tries to Trick AI Coding Agent Into Installing Malware
stories.summary: A malicious instruction file sitting in a developer's Downloads folder tried to make their AI coding agent install a known-malicious npm package, security firm Forever Security said in a report published last week. stories.title: Node2Shell: Brotli Flaw Triggers Patching Across Microsoft, Node.js, Python Packages
stories.summary: An out-of-bounds write in Google’s Brotli decoder affects Node.js, .NET, PowerShell, and Python packages, and can lead to code execution.

stories.title: [UPDATE] [hoch] Microsoft Apps: Mehrere Schwachstellen ermöglichen Privilegieneskalation
stories.summary: Ein Angreifer kann mehrere Schwachstellen in Microsoft Authenticator und Microsoft Xbox Gaming Services ausnutzen, um seine Privilegien zu erhöhen.
